basis_note: ES bars anchored to ESU6 (tradeable front; maps to /MESU6); newest bars are UNADJUSTED and adjustment_offset=0, so recent levels/AVWAP map 1:1 to /MES. Daily is back-adjusted for the 200-day MA, so OLDER daily bars are shifted by historical roll gaps — only the RECENT (front-month) bars are unadjusted /MES prices.
source: Polygon futures continuous back-adjusted (front-month + prior quarterlies)

vp.basis: VRVP over the published bar range — volume distributed across each bar's [low,high] (real bar volume); 70% value area. D88: replaces single-bin typical-price method.

honesty: Intraday futures bars are exchange-DELAYED (Polygon, ~hours on this plan). For live ticks use ToS. Redraws on the publish cadence (~60-75s), not per tick. ES live last-price comes from the IQFeed snapshot. DAILY = CONTINUOUS back-adjusted ES (265 bars; prior ES quarterlies stitched at each roll and shifted by the roll gap) so the 200-day SMA/EMA (death-cross line) is computable. Most-recent bars are the unadjusted front-month ESU6; the wave read uses this same series so pivots align to the candles.
